name: Kitanagoya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kitanagoya city emblem in green and blue: a green stylised sprout with blue leaves and a blue ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kitanagoya, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 November 2006.

features.role: Kitanagoya city emblem — a green stylised sprout with blue leaves and a blue ring
